detailed_description: The Color Name Finder finds nearby named colors for one browser-side color value. You can choose a color with the native color picker, edit the hex input, click Find, and review the returned matches with a color swatch, name, hex value, and distance number from the local findClosestColor helper. The tool is useful for quick approximate naming, but it does not accept RGB or HSL text input, provide sliders, update results automatically while editing, copy values to the clipboard, show LAB details, calculate contrast ratios, convert to Pantone or CMYK, or use CIEDE2000 color-difference scoring.
usage_steps: Choose a color with the color picker or edit the hex input.
Click Find to look up nearby named colors.
Review the returned swatches, names, hex values, and distance numbers.
Adjust the hex value and run Find again when you want to compare another color.
usage_examples: Find an approximate human-readable name for a hex color while drafting UI notes.
Compare nearby named color matches for a chosen browser color.
Use the swatch and hex output as a quick reference during a small design task.
Test another hex value by editing the input and clicking Find again.
